title: webCLI
description: Twelve tools that run in a browser tab: what goes in, what comes out, what each one is not, and how far to trust it.
author: Tejaswi Gowda

customize.css: :root{--bg:#fbfbfa;--fg:#1b1d1f;--muted:#5b6168;--rule:#d9dcdf;--card:#fff;--code:#f0f1f2;--link:#0b5cad;--ok:#1d6b3a;--warn:#8a4b00;--font:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;--size:16px}@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#131517;--fg:#e6e8ea;--muted:#9aa1a8;--rule:#2d3136;--card:#1a1d20;--code:#22262a;--link:#7db4f0;--ok:#6fcf8f;--warn:#e0a860}}body{font:1rem/1.55 var(--font)}.wrap{max-width:52rem;padding:1rem;margin:0 auto}header.site{display:none}.posts:empty{display:none}h1{font:700 2rem/1.2 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;margin:1rem 0 .5rem}h2{font-size:1.25rem;margin:2.2rem 0 .6rem;padding-top:.4rem;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);scroll-margin-top:1rem}h3{font-size:1rem;margin:1.6rem 0 .4rem}p.lead{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted);max-width:42rem}.section-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.25rem .9rem;margin-top:.8rem}.section-nav a{padding:.35rem 0}.tool{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;padding:.8rem 1rem;margin:.8rem 0}.tool:after{content:"";display:block;clear:both}.tool .thumb{float:right;width:18rem;max-width:45%;margin:0 0 .6rem 1rem}.tool .thumb img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px}.tool h4{margin:0 0 .2rem;font:700 1rem/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace}.tool p{margin:.2rem 0}.tool dl{margin:.5rem 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:5.5rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:.15rem .6rem;font-size:.9rem}.tool dt{color:var(--muted)}.tool dd{margin:0;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.tool code{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.badge{display:inline-block;font:400 .75rem/1.5 var(--font);padding:.05rem .5rem;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:99px;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:.4rem}.badge.yes{color:var(--ok);font-weight:600}.badge.no{color:var(--muted)}.caveat{color:var(--warn);font-size:.9rem}.meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}code,pre{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.5}pre{padding:.8rem;border-radius:6px;max-width:100%;margin:.5rem 0}pre code{font-size:inherit}figure{margin:.8rem 0}figure img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px}figcaption{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;margin-top:.4rem}a:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--link);outline-offset:2px}footer.site{margin:2rem 0 1rem;padding:0;border:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}.home-after table{font-size:.9rem}article[data-page]>h1{display:none}@media(max-width:30rem){.wrap{padding:.75rem}.tool .thumb{float:none;width:100%;max-width:100%;margin:0 0 .6rem}.tool dl{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:0}.tool dd{margin-bottom:.3rem}}
